messages:
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: POC workshop — looking to align on samples and calendar

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Acme Health is excited to move to a hands-on POC so our engineering team can validate prompt routing and throughput concerns. Two quick asks to get the kickoff on the calendar:

1) Can you send a short checklist of sample payloads you need (format, redaction guidance, anonymization examples)?
2) We need a couple of proposed time windows next week for a 2-hour working session (prompt review, routing scenarios, brief load test). We prefer late-morning PT or early-afternoon ET.

We'd like the session to include one of your SEs and someone from product if possible. I'll loop in David from infra for the data transfer and SSO side.

Best,
Sara Jenkins
Product Lead, Integrations
Acme Health

--
Attachment: none in this message
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acmehealth.com>
Cc: David Li <d.li@acmehealth.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC workshop — looking to align on samples and calendar

Hi Sara —

Great to hear — excited to get this moving. Proposed windows for a 2-hour working session next week (all PT):

- Tue 27 Apr, 10:00–12:00
- Wed 28 Apr, 11:00–13:00
- Thu 29 Apr, 09:30–11:30

Please pick any that work and I will send a calendar invite. Rafael will join as SE for prompt/routing details; Markus (cc'd separately) will be on standby for executive-level items if needed.

Attached is a starter checklist (sample_payloads_template.csv) and our redaction guideline summary (redaction_guidelines.pdf). Quick notes on samples:

- Provide 200–500 representative prompts (real*ish* distribution) for each route you care about.
- Label examples by intent (e.g., triage, summarization, code-gen) in a column.
- Replace PHI with {REDACTED} tokens; if you must include structure (dates, IDs) use fictionalized but syntactically similar values.
- For routing tests: include at least 50 short prompts (<20 tokens) and 50 long prompts (>200 tokens).

Data transfer options: 
- Secure Drive folder (preferred) — we can provide a write-only folder link.
- SFTP endpoint (for larger blobs).

I'll also include an agenda template and a short checklist of what we'll run during the 2-hour session (prompt review, routing matrix + expected outputs, 20-min burst load test at 200 rps, evaluation rubric pass/fail criteria).

Attachments: sample_payloads_template.csv, redaction_guidelines.pdf

Thanks — talk soon,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

Cc: David Li <d.li@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC workshop — looking to align on samples and calendar

Hi all — quick technical notes ahead of scheduling: 

- For the burst load test I recommend we prepare two payload sets: a) \"control\" (small prompts, ~10 tokens) and b) \"heavy\" (sequences with >256 tokens). We'll run both at incremental qps up to the target RPS and monitor latency P95.
- Please include any rate limits or proxy latency you currently see so we can configure realistic routing.
- If you plan to test with real customer data we need a signed data-handling addendum — otherwise use anonymized/fake data per Vanessa's redaction sheet.

Agenda snippet I will present: prompt routing matrix, expected tokenization, KV-cache behavior during long-turn interactions, and a simple failure/fallback demo.

I can be available Tue 27 (morning) and Thu 29 (morning).

-Rafael
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai

We want to avoid a very early start on our side (we're on PT but some of our team is in ET). Can we shift to Wed 28 Apr, 12:00–14:00 PT (so that becomes 15:00–17:00 ET)? That would give David time to gather sample exports.

Also: two compliance items —
1) We will only upload de-identified CSVs (PHI redacted); please confirm your team will not retain raw copies after the workshop beyond logs required for debugging.
2) We need the session recorded for internal review; please confirm recordings are allowed and whether Redwood can redact transcripts on request.

Happy to proceed once we have that confirmed and the Drive link.

—Sara

Sara — thanks for the quick reply and good catches on compliance. Wed 28 Apr, 12:00–14:00 PT works for us; calendar invite sent to the group (watch for a separate invite from Calendly).

Quick answers to your compliance questions: 
- Data retention: Redwood will only keep logs necessary for debugging and operational telemetry for 30 days by default for POC work; we can sign a short addendum to clarify we will not retain raw uploads beyond that window. I'll have legal draft the one-paragraph addendum and share via DocuSign.
- Recording: recordings are allowed, and we can redact transcripts on request. We'll store the recording in a secure bucket and only share the Drive link to your specified distribution list. If you need immediate redaction, flag the timestamp and we'll apply the transcript redaction workflow.

Drive link (write access granted to Acme SSO accounts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcme-POC-Data
HubSpot record: HS-58291

Action items for Acme before the Wed session:
- Upload anonymized CSVs per the attached template (sample_payloads_template.csv).
- Add an intent column and one column with expected output patterns (high-level).
- Confirm which routes you want exercised (intent-to-model mapping).

I'll attach the working session agenda (working_session_agenda.odt) and the redaction guidelines again. Rafael — can you prepare the burst-load script and a short runbook for the 20-min stress test?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
